decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the use is commenced.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for support service purposes shall not be carried out outside the following times: 8 am to 8 pm Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted relates to the room referred to as an office on the approved plans only.  This room shall be used as an office for support services or residential purposes only, and for no other purpose.  The rest of the property shall continue to be used as a single family dwellinghouse.
Condition : 6 - All existing signage shall be removed prior to the commencement of the use on site.
description: Change of use of ground floor front room to use as office to provide advice/support to pensioners/victims of crime.
